##### Project general facts

Rosehill offers a serene collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to harmonize with nature and elevate everyday living. Each home is bathed in natural light, framed by lush gardens and panoramic vistas of the Dubai Hills Golf Course. With open-air terraces and soft landscaping, the residences embrace a calming connection between indoor elegance and outdoor tranquility.

Residents at Rosehill are immersed in an abundance of premium amenities designed to enhance wellbeing and leisure. From the shimmering swimming pool and outdoor gym to the padel court, botanical garden, and table tennis zone, every element encourages vibrant, active living. Children are treated to both indoor and outdoor play areas, while peaceful courtyards and communal seating decks provide quiet spots for relaxation.

Set in the heart of Dubai Hills Estate, Rosehill blends luxury with the vitality of nature in a truly exceptional way. Surrounded by iconic landmarks like Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Hills Park, and a championship golf course, life here is rich with choice and charm. With every detail artfully curated, Rosehill delivers a lifestyle that is grounded in beauty, balance, and belonging.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Hills is a prestigious and vibrant master-planned community located in the heart of Dubai. Developed by Emaar Properties in collaboration with Meraas Holding, it represents a harmonious blend of luxury living, natural beauty, and modern urban design.

At the heart of Dubai Hills is the stunning 18-hole championship golf course, designed to international standards. The golf course adds a touch of greenery and serenity to the landscape, attracting golf enthusiasts from around the world.

Dubai Hills is not just a residential development - it's a comprehensive lifestyle destination. The Dubai Hills Mall, a world-class shopping and entertainment center, offers an array of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Residents and visitors can also enjoy the Central Park, a vast expanse of greenery and relaxation.
